target: Treatment-minus-control DGM RMST and RMUT contrasts at the scheduled method-specific restriction windows (Table S2E).

numerical_method.integration: Trapezoidal integration of bivariate-lognormal composite survival differences and utility-weighted survival differences.
numerical_method.composite_survival: Sum over mixture components of weight times Phi_2(-a(t), -b(t); rho).
numerical_method.death_survival: Sum over mixture components of weight times [1-Phi(b(t))].
numerical_method.cdf_evaluation: scipy.stats.multivariate_normal frozen two-dimensional cdf with its default numerical settings.
numerical_method.RMUT_weight_source: Locked trial_process.csv field RMUT_w_R; all four released cases use 0.5.

precision_note: The saved table is not overwritten. Compare numerical values within the stated tolerance; floating-point CSV formatting need not be byte-identical. Cross-version bitwise equality is not promised. The calculation adds no trial-data, DGM-fit or structural uncertainty.
